headline: Walk-in mental health centres to open in banks and libraries
summary: England plans nearly 200 specialist walk-in services in everyday public buildings to help people facing mental health crises.
script: England will open walk-in mental health centres in banks, libraries and community buildings. The government plans nearly two hundred specialist services, so people in crisis can get help without an appointment.
